verdict.rationale: Daily's global mesh network guide says its routing architecture reduces latency, packet loss, and jitter for calls worldwide. That is a qualitative description of the latency path, not a stated end-to-end latency target or measured figure. missing for 10: a numeric end-to-end latency target (e.g. a ms budget), measured latency benchmarks or path breakdown, latency figures for voice-AI/live conversation use, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation

citations.quote: In many cases, this reduces the latency, packet loss, and jitter — improving the overall call experience for end users around the globe.
